items.text: I repaired the small shoreline gap with one boundary-vertex move. The map now covers the modeled shoreline, keeps every cell convex and above the shape bound, and assigns all 5,986 pickups; its variance stayed at **3,048**. I’m making that boundary check part of every future rim move so the run cannot recreate the gap.
